summary: The bad() entry point renders a login form with method="get", which causes the submitted username and password to be appended to the URL as query-string parameters (CWE-598: Information Exposure Through Query String). Query strings are logged, cached, and stored in browser history/referrer headers, exposing the credentials. The fix changes the form submission method to POST, which places the form fields in the request body instead of the URL, preserving the login functionality while preventing credential exposure.
